com.sun.corba.se.impl.protocol.giopmsgheaders

类 MessageBase

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.sun.corba.se.impl.protocol.giopmsgheaders.MessageBase
  • 所有已实现的接口:
    Message
    直接已知子类:
    Message_1_0, Message_1_1

    public abstract class MessageBase
extends Object
implements Message
    This class acts as the base class for the various GIOP message types. This also serves as a factory to create various message types. We currently support GIOP 1.0, 1.1 and 1.2 message types.
    作者:
    Ram Jeyaraman 05/14/2000
